title: mesh-history-card/1 — record schema (Home-2 semantics)
description: Validates the `history` object carried at model_attestation.compute_attestation['x-mesh-history-v1'].history of a sealed capsule (capsule-emit-mesh history_card.py). Covers ONLY the semantic content -- the cryptographic chain-walk (consistency proofs, COSE-wire checkpoints) is verified offline by history_card.verify_history_card, not re-checked here; this schema only fixes the SHAPE and the closed vocab of `continuity`/`unforked`.

continuity.description: Not a closed enum -- carries a variable 'broken at mmr_size=<N>: <reason>' message on failure (open_questions flags whether 'unbroken' / 'no checkpoints since the requested size' / a 'broken at ...' prefix should become the registered closed set).
